clips.title: The story
paras: The Trogg Threat is an Alliance quest issued by Captain Rugelfuss at the Southern Gate of Loch Modan. With the local Ironforge Reserve called away to support Alliance battlefronts, the remaining defenders are stretched thin against the hostile trogg tribes in the hills. Adventurers are tasked with culling the troggs and returning with their stone teeth to relieve pressure on the mountain pass.

The defensive line guarding the southern approach into Loch Modan is in a precarious state. The regular dwarven mountaineers and Ironforge Reserve regiments have been dispatched to reinforce broader Alliance war fronts, leaving Captain Rugelfuss and a skeleton garrison stationed at the southern guard tower. Constrained by strict orders not to abandon the gate, Rugelfuss cannot mount an active offensive into the highlands, leaving nearby settlers and travelers vulnerable to ambushes.

Troggs residing in the surrounding crags pose an escalating danger to Khaz Modan. Left unchecked, their numbers swell quickly, threatening to overrun dwarven outposts. To buy time and thin the menace, Rugelfuss calls upon wandering adventurers to assault the troggs directly in their hillside warrens and present severed stone teeth as physical confirmation of the deed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Adventurer, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands. With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe. My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.
But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills. If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs. Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me? If not, there is still work to be done, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am quite impressed, friend. You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands. King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
